title: Up One Side, Down the Other
reference: F1(3) def F1 { forward turn_left forward turn_right F1 forward turn_right forward turn_left }
hints: The way up is stairs. The way down is the same stairs turned the other way, and it runs after the call.
F1: forward, turn left, forward, turn right, F1, forward, turn right, forward, turn left.
F1(3) def F1 { forward turn_left forward turn_right F1 forward turn_right forward turn_left }

story.intro: PATCH: "A peak in the plaza. One function can build both slopes: up before the call, down after it."
story.outro: PATCH: "Up three, down three. The calls kept count for you."
